cases.type: Athletic Country Club / family, sport and lifestyle destination
cases.core_model: Opened 2026-10-12; over 180,000 sq ft across 86,000-sq-ft club, ~50,000-sq-ft beach club and ~50,000-sq-ft pickleball retreat; 14 pickleball courts and integrated training, recovery, hospitality, coworking and childcare.
cases.target_members: Affluent suburban households and multi-generational families seeking sport, leisure, work and wellness in one destination.
cases.service_mechanism: Combines personal training, group classes, recovery, chiropractic clinic, cafe, coworking and Kids Academy; member app and athletic events extend service beyond the site.
cases.community_mechanism: Family recreation, 14 pickleball courts, pool/beach social areas and club events create repeatable non-gym reasons to visit.
cases.why_it_may_work: Bundling multiple household activities can increase use cases, convenience and perceived membership value; specific retention and economics are not disclosed.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Build the service logic of a daily-life club: good changing/recovery fundamentals, member lounge, events and a testable family-friendly schedule. Treat sport and childcare as conditional demand-driven modules.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not copy the 180,000-sq-ft destination scale, beach club, 14 courts or full Kids Academy into a dense urban flagship without proven local demand and site economics.
cases.investment_decision: Build core training and service; partner or pilot family/sports extensions; defer resort-scale amenities.
cases.evidence_status: High for opening, floor areas and announced facilities (official 2026-10-12 release); low for long-term retention or financial outcomes.

The Circle cafe/coworking and membership app

cases.evidence_status: High for official listed facilities, membership tiers and operating claim; medium for service delivery; low for independently verified performance/health benefits.

cases.city: West Chelsea, New York City, USA
cases.type: Destination-tier luxury performance club / strength x recovery
cases.core_model: Restored 1891 landmark at 261 11th Avenue. Official showroom is open; Athletech News reported planned club opening November 10, 2026. Integrates a reported 7,000-sq-ft strength floor, PGX functional-strength/HIIT circuits, dedicated Reformer Pilates, sauna/steam/cold showers, retail, member lounge and digital EQX+ content.
cases.target_members: Premium urban professionals and serious strength/hybrid trainees seeking a higher-performance club and elevated service environment.
investment_modules: Strength floor with Olympic platforms and functional training equipment
Contrast therapy sauna, steam and cold showers
Member lounge, coworking and curated retail
cases.service_mechanism: Performance-first training plus instructor-led classes and recovery; club-specific access/membership terms need confirmation. Brand's own page lists showroom open, not full club operation.
cases.community_mechanism: Team-based PGX circuits, classes and shared lounge are intended to create repeated coached interaction; no independently verified retention outcomes.
cases.why_it_may_work: A differentiated high-performance destination can give advanced members a clear reason to choose or upgrade club access; the integrated training-to-recovery journey may increase perceived utility. This is a hypothesis, not observed economics.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Study training-floor capacity and coach-led hybrid strength as a destination product. Prioritize serious strength equipment, programming and recovery-adjacent changing; evaluate dedicated Pilates and social space against utilization.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not copy landmark renovation, destination-tier pricing or large footprint without demand and operational proof. Equinox's recovery marketing claims are not independent clinical evidence.

investment_modules: Strength/functional training floor and dedicated HYROX zone
19-place Reformer Pilates studio and other specialized studios
Recovery zone with Normatec and Hyperice
Wet spa and premium changing rooms
Optional wash/dry/fold and monthly locker rental
cases.service_mechanism: Official site describes personal trainers with minimum 2,500 session hours, at least five internal academy education days annually and a three-year PT development journey; Elite PT category lists 10,000+ hours. Published Queen's Park club-only membership £265, Group £299, Group Plus £345, subject to joining fees and access terms as shown on 2026-10-29.

cases.city: United States and Canada (Life Time pickleball clubs)
cases.type: Digital member product / skill-based community matchmaking
cases.core_model: On October 21, 2026 Life Time announced completed integration of Dynamic Universal Pickleball Rating (DUPR) into its app across all clubs offering pickleball. Members can link their rating to club membership, track progress, find level-matched partners and join rating-gated or open-level leagues/play.
cases.target_members: Pickleball members seeking appropriate competition, measurable improvement and more convenient repeat participation.
investment_modules: Member app integration with external sport-rating system
Level-matched class, league and partner discovery
Coach-led skill assessment and community moderation
cases.service_mechanism: Existing Life Time member ID links to DUPR; rating appears alongside court booking tools; clubs can offer rating-gated Open Play as well as non-rated formats, with pros available to guide members.
cases.community_mechanism: Skill-matched leagues and open play reduce coordination friction, help newcomers find compatible peers and give advanced players measurable progression.
cases.why_it_may_work: A verified ability signal can improve matching, fairness and repeat use of existing facilities. Business impact is not yet independently disclosed.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Apply the principle to running/strength: ability and goals -> appropriate coach, training group, challenge or race prep. Pilot simple levels, opt-in profiles and coach validation before investing in custom scoring software.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not build a proprietary rating system without critical mass or sport-specific validity. Avoid excluding beginners and respect consent/privacy for member performance data.
cases.investment_decision: Partner or integrate existing validated ratings; build member journeys and coach matching; pilot level-based groups before custom software.
cases.evidence_status: High for official announced completed rollout and product features (Life Time release 2026-10-21); retention or commercial lift not publicly verified.

cases.city: Chaowai SOHO, Beijing, China (official site address; current operations unverified)
cases.core_model: Official SHARPN BlackTurf site describes a Beijing athlete-style conditioning gym with standardized team-based strength, speed, agility and conditioning sessions on a black ATTACK turf floor. Sessions vary by focus while preserving shared structure and a 'Super Warm-up'.
cases.target_members: Fitness enthusiasts and beginners who want to train like athletes, with team energy and structured conditioning.
investment_modules: Coach training, class standards and intensity scaling
Group rituals and post-class social connection
cases.service_mechanism: Official site describes ~60-minute sessions including warm-up and cool-down, maximum one session per person per day, different daily focuses, consistent program standards and instructor delivery style. TURF 101 recommended for newcomers.
cases.community_mechanism: Teams train together, support each other, share opening/closing rituals and are encouraged to take post-class photos rather than use phones during class.
cases.why_it_may_work: Repeatable program architecture and strong rituals can create identity and social adherence; independently verified attendance and retention data are unavailable.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Study the TURF 101 onboarding pathway and the balance of standardized programming with coach personality. Pilot an athlete-style group training line that complements rather than replaces serious strength training.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not copy extreme intensity or branding as a universal default. Verify current operating location and ensure progression, safety and beginner accessibility. Do not treat SHARPN MASS as the same format.
cases.investment_decision: Build standardized coaching and beginner progression; pilot turf-style group conditioning; verify location/operations before direct competitor comparison.
cases.evidence_status: High for historical brand identity and published program mechanics from official website; current operation, exact active venue and affiliation with MASS remain unverified.

cases.city: Beijing and Shanghai, China (historical mainland operations)
cases.type: Historical boutique fitness / music-led immersive classes / prepaid membership caution
cases.core_model: SpaceCycle built a premium class experience around cycling, music, lights, coach personality, studio quality and high-service changing rooms. Jiemian/Focus One reported mainland Beijing/Shanghai operations ceased from May 1, 2024 following liquidation notice, with member prepaid balances disputed. Official brand site is older and must not be read as current store evidence.
cases.target_members: Historically premium urban boutique-class consumers seeking immersive workouts, coach relationships, community and convenience.
investment_modules: Coach identity and recurring member relationships
Transparent prepaid service obligations and member trust
cases.service_mechanism: Historically immersive classes, carefully serviced changing rooms and social waiting spaces. Reports of sudden closure and outstanding prepaid lessons make consumer trust and continuity central negative lessons.
cases.community_mechanism: Strong coach-led communities and social identity were reported by former members; some continued following coaches after closures.
cases.why_it_may_work: Strong atmosphere and personal instructor connection created perceived differentiation, but brand affinity did not prevent operating failure. Membership prepaid revenue cannot be treated as earned service value.
cases.plus5lbs_takeaway: Learn from coach culture, cleaning cadence, showers and between-class social comfort; separately design customer-funds protection, fulfillment obligations, refund transparency and continuity plans.
cases.avoid_copying: Do not copy aggressive prepaid selling, costly experiential build-out or dependence on star instructors without resilient service economics. Do not label mainland Space as currently operating.
cases.investment_decision: Build service quality and coach standards; selectively pilot immersive formats; establish prepaid liability governance; defer heavy sensory build-out.
cases.evidence_status: High for historical brand concept (official archived site); medium-high for 2024 mainland closure and member accounts (Jiemian/Focus One report); current status of any separate Taiwan operations not assessed.
